The '''Pyramid of the Moon''' is the second-largest temple in the Aztec capital of [[Teotihuacan, Mexico]], situated near the [[Pyramid of the Sun]].

== History ==
The Pyramid of the Moon was built by an ancient unknown Meso-American culture. Another temple, the [[Pyramid of the Sun]] was built in the city nearby, and an ancient Pyramidallion was hidden between them. {{Source|TCG:LGS-B4|LGS-B4}}
